## Landed and verified (2026-11-16)

- Gerrit 3403 (`Shrink the bd66 detector's maintenance threshold`) merged as 4917b500b84 after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, submitted revision-scoped at 7dbcab237f9. Test-only change to tests/unit/test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py.
- `pytest tests/unit/test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py -q -n 4`: 10 of 10 consecutive runs passed (4 passed each, 39-60 s) while a full `make verify` and other sessions' verifies ran; load average 17-44 on 18 CPUs.
- `make verify` on the fix commit, run 1: 4 failed, 21291 passed (2 h 60 min, load 40-70). All 4 failures were `infra/scripts/observability.sh` subprocesses exceeding their tests' 60 s bound, in tests/scripts/test_observability_rotation_2dc7.py and test_observability_reviewbot_webhook_auth.py; bd66 passed; the same 2 files alone passed 10 of 10. Filed as `undefeated-famed-platypus` (discovered_from this ticket).
- `make verify` run 2 on the same commit: exit 0 (21295 passed, 29 skipped; integration tier 218 passed, 2 skipped).
- AC boxes checked; AC1 annotated that the trace showed a fourth mechanism rather than one of the three candidates.

Unresolved by evidence: the single 2026-10-26 assertion-mode failure (commits traced, no maintenance descendant) was not reproduced. Gerrit 3135's diagnosis still runs on that path, and the fix does not change it.
